lines.text: Alright team, let's get to work.
Rise and shine, everybody. Big day.
Let's do this by the book.
Fresh map, fresh start. Move out!
I've got a good feeling about this one.
Let's make this quick and clean.
Welcome to the Sanpete Valley, friends.
We need more workers on that patch.
A busy worker is a happy worker.
Faster, please. We have bills to pay.
More grubs! The larder's looking thin.
More ore! We need more ore!
That spot looks good. Build it.
New headquarters is open for business.
A second base. Now we're talking.
A brand new HQ. The dean would be proud.
Barracks are ready. Time to train.
Housing is done. Recruits, report in.
Now we can build an army.
The barracks are up and running.
We have a place to train fighters.
The dorms are finished. Move in, badgers!
Barracks complete. Let's raise some troops.
New depot. Shorter walks for everyone.
The lab is ready. Let's get smart.
The makerspace is open. Let's tinker.
Our tower is watching the approach.
That's one tall problem for the enemy.
The bell tower stands. Ring it loud!
A new badger joins the dig.
One more for the front line.
Stay behind the soldiers and shoot.
Let them have it from afar.
A badger with a bow. Terrifying.
Fast and curious. Go look around.
Now's our chance. Go, go, go!
Poor badger. Back to the burrow.
How did they get in here?
Ring the bell! Badgers in danger!
Knock, knock. Oh, no door anymore.
I just finished paying for that.
Get the builders ready. We'll need them.
That tower was worth every penny.
That should give us an edge.
Looking good, team. Keep it up.
Come on, team, pick it up!
Okay, okay, we can fix this.
I've seen better strategies in a cereal box.
My grandmother attacks faster than that.
Have you tried turning it off and on again?
That's a lot of confidence for so few units.
We can hear you coming, you know.
Let me know when you want to start.
Somebody forgot to read the bot guide.
I'll give you a head start. Oh wait.
Your code has a bug, and it's your strategy.
Error four oh four: defense not found.
You're going to need a bigger army.
Hey, nice workers. I'll take them.
I've got more units than you have ideas.
This will be over before lunch.
Grubs for us, tears for you.
Honey badgers don't care, and neither do we.
Your ore is my ore now.
Check the map, check it again.
Who left the lights on in the barracks?
I love the smell of strategy in the morning.
Nice day in Ephraim, isn't it?
Somebody grab me a scone from the Co-op.
Tell my bot I loved it.
We'll be back. Count on it.
Well, that didn't go to plan.
Retreat! Wait, there's nowhere to go.
Off to hibernate. Wake me next season.
And that's how you do it.
Go Badgers! Top badger, right here!
Well played. I hate it, but well played.
